description: This file defines the FinishResponseSubscriber class, which implements event handling for HTTP responses in Drupal, including setting cache headers, security headers, and debugging headers.

classes.name: FinishResponseSubscriber
classes.description: Handles setting headers and cache policies for HTTP responses in Drupal, implementing event subscriber interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the subscriber with dependencies such as language manager, cache policies, and debug options.

methods.name: onAllResponds
methods.description: Adds a cache tag to all responses for invalidation purposes.

methods.name: onRespond
methods.description: Sets security, cache, and debugging headers on main responses based on policies and configuration.

methods.name: isCacheControlCustomized
methods.description: Checks if the response has a custom Cache-Control header set.

methods.name: setResponseNotCacheable
methods.description: Sets headers to prevent caching of the response.

methods.name: setResponseCacheable
methods.description: Sets headers to enable caching of the response, including cache max-age, ETag, and Last-Modified.

methods.name: setCacheControlNoCache
methods.description: Sets Cache-Control header to prevent caching.

methods.name: setExpiresNoCache
methods.description: Sets the Expires header to a past date to prevent caching.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event listeners for response events, ensuring headers are set appropriately.
